title: Two Hops to the Answer
briefMd:
# Advanced · Two Hops to the Answer

Some questions are only answered by a chain of pages. "What is the nightly hotel limit for the design summit?" needs the event page (the summit is in Porto) and then the travel page for Porto, one of sixteen near-identical city pages. Searching with the question alone finds the event page but has no way to pick the right city.

Retrieval is BM25 over whole pages. You control:

- **topK**: results per search.
- **hops**: 1 searches once; 2 runs a second search built from the question and the top **hopSeeds** passages of the first.
- **hopQuery**: what the second search adds to the question: the seed passages in full (`passage`), or only the names they mention that the question does not (`entities`, such as "Porto").

The context holds the results of every search, and every passage in it counts toward the budget. A question counts as answered only when every page of its chain is in the context.

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90 (every link of the chain in context) and mean prompt tokens ≤ 220 on the hidden set.

hops.description: 1 searches once; 2 searches again with the question plus what the first search found.

hopSeeds.description: How many passages from the first search are added to the second query.

hopQuery.description: What the second search adds to the question: the seed passages in full, or only the new names they mention.
